name: COVERAGE_M3P_ELECT_REQS
description: Clarity table for related group CVG 940 - M3P Election Requests.

columns.name: COVERAGE_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the coverage record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: M3P_ELECT_REQ_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The date and time in which a member submits an election request for the Medicare Prescription Payment Plan.

columns.name: M3P_REQ_STATUS_C_NAME
columns.description: The Request Status category ID for the Medicare Prescription Payment Plan election request.

columns.name: M3P_STATUS_REASON_C_NAME
columns.description: The Status Reason category ID for the Medicare Prescription Payment Plan election request.

columns.name: M3P_SOURCE_TYPE_C_NAME
columns.description: The Source Type category ID for the Medicare Prescription Payment Plan election request.

columns.name: M3P_PLAN_YEAR
columns.description: The plan year the member is electing to opt into the Medicare Prescription Payment Plan for.
